original_prompt: A closed book is pushed past the edge of a shelf, falls, and lands open on the floor.

initial_condition.description: A visible hand pushes the book toward the open end of the shelf.

pre_event_image_prompt: A realistic fixed wide side-view photograph of one closed blue-edged book near the right end of a wooden shelf. One visible hand at the left is pushing the book rightward toward the shelf edge, with the book still fully supported and closed. Show the empty vertical space below the edge and the wooden floor in the same frame, leaving a clear uninterrupted fall path. Shelf, hand, book, and landing area are fully visible. One continuous 1280x704 landscape frame.
text_policy: pre_event_image_prompt is used verbatim for image generation
